name: Alice Shido
title: Founder Panta Rhei Studio
quote:
I’ve had coaching with Moritz for about a year now, and I’m very happy! When we started, my business was stuck. I thought maybe I didn’t like my job anymore, and I was almost giving up. Moritz helped me realign with what’s important to me and double my clients and revenue. 
With time, things are only getting better. I feel more confident and enthusiastic about my business. There’s room for more growth and next steps, without actually working harder, but with more enjoyment! It’s an investment that came back and was really worth doing. Something I particularly appreciate about Moritz is that he spreads kindness and honesty, encouraging a human and sustainable business model, which is really liberating and rewarding. Thank you, Moritz!
